podcast.body: On this song from The Smashing Pumpkins' 1993 album "Cher Brock", Jimmy Chamberlin's drumming showcases a subtle swing in his rhythm and a masterful use of hi-hats to provide a solid anchor for the band's performance. His background as an "X-Swing and Big Band drummer" is evident in his sophisticated approach. "Pay attention to the slight swing in Jimmy's rhythm and how he uses the hi-hats to anchor everything that he and the band does."
